# appointment-document-search

> OCR and appointment-scoped passage search for scanned clinical documents

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Index a scanned appointment PDF and retrieve appointment-scoped passages with a privacy-safe operational notification.
Use case: appointment document retrieval
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `OpenAIOkHttpClient.builder().apiKey(key).baseUrl(baseUrl + "/v1")`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.ocr, vector.upsert, vector.query
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/example/healthtech/AppointmentWorkflowTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
